instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary throughout the movement.
Curl the barbell up towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
data.name: ez barbell close-grip curl

reviewedInterpretation: 站姿EZ曲杆窄距反握弯举，双手握内侧倾斜握段，手间距明显窄于肩；肘贴体，上臂固定，只有前臂随肘屈抬杠至肩前，再受控回低位。

references.clarification: The publisher specifies a narrow hand spacing and fixed upper arms for its close-grip EZ curl. No external images or video were used.

reviewNotes: Pinned English step1 says shoulder-width despite the close-grip title.
Interpret inner EZ grips as distinctly narrower than shoulders, avoiding arbitrary human centimetre scaling on the plush mascot.
Do not replace the curved EZ bar with a straight bar or dumbbells.
